### workspace pipeline --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace pipeline start PROJECT --work-item REF [--body TEXT] [--json]
       workspace pipeline advance PROJECT --work-item REF [--body TEXT] [--json]
       workspace pipeline status PROJECT [--json]
       workspace pipeline reset PROJECT [--json]

Deprecated: use `workspace workflow`, which runs ordered steps in a workspace's agent pane
and shows where a run is stuck. `pipeline` will be removed in a later release.

  start    Send a work item into a project's pipeline
  advance  Mark a work item's running stage complete and move on
  status   Show what a project has in flight
  reset    Clear a stopped project's pipeline state

Examples:
  workspace pipeline start myapp --work-item WC-42    # hand WC-42 to myapp's agent with the default message
  workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42    # push WC-42 past a stage that is done but did not say so
  workspace pipeline status myapp    # what is myapp working on, and when is each stage due
  workspace pipeline reset myapp    # clear leftover state after stopping myapp's agent
  workspace pipeline start --help    # read the page of one subcommand
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace pipeline start --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace pipeline start PROJECT --work-item REF [--body TEXT] [--json]

Send a work item into a project's pipeline.

This command will be removed in a later release; use `workspace workflow`.

Sends the item to the project's running agent daemon (no_daemon when none runs), which takes it
from there. This changes the project's pipeline state for real.

Options:
    --work-item REF              Work item reference (e.g. WC-42)
    --body TEXT                  The message to send (default: "Begin work on REF.")
    --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace pipeline start myapp --work-item WC-42    # hand WC-42 to myapp's agent with the default message
  workspace pipeline start myapp --work-item WC-42 --body "/build add OAuth support"    # say what the first stage should do
  workspace pipeline start myapp --work-item WC-42 --json    # for a script: one action document, with an error document and code when no agent runs
--- stderr
Warning: `workspace pipeline` is deprecated and will be removed in a later release. Use `workspace workflow` (see `workspace workflow --help`).
--- end

### workspace pipeline advance --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace pipeline advance PROJECT --work-item REF [--body TEXT] [--json]

Mark a work item's running stage complete and move on.

This command will be removed in a later release; use `workspace workflow`.

Interrupts whatever the stage's pane is doing (Ctrl-C), then types the completion sentinel, even if
the stage has not finished. Needs the project's agent daemon and a stage running for REF.

Options:
    --work-item REF              Work item reference (e.g. WC-42)
    --body TEXT                  The text after the sentinel (default: "manual advance")
    --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42    # push WC-42 past a stage that is done but did not say so
  workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42 --body "done by hand"    # record why you pushed it on, e.g. a stage you finished by hand
  workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42 --json    # for a script: one action document
--- stderr
Warning: `workspace pipeline` is deprecated and will be removed in a later release. Use `workspace workflow` (see `workspace workflow --help`).
--- end

Needs the project's agent daemon and a stage running for REF.","options":[{"flags":"--work-item REF","description":"Work item reference (e.g. WC-42)"},{"flags":"--body TEXT","description":"The text after the sentinel (default: \"manual advance\")"},{"flags":"--json","description":"Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text"},{"flags":"-h, --help","description":"Show this help"}],"examples":[{"command":"workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42","scenario":"push WC-42 past a stage that is done but did not say so"},{"command":"workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42 --body \"done by hand\"","scenario":"record why you pushed it on, e.g. a stage you finished by hand"},{"command":"workspace pipeline advance myapp --work-item WC-42 --json","scenario":"for a script: one action document"}]}

### workspace pipeline status --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace pipeline status PROJECT [--json]

Show what a project has in flight.

This command will be removed in a later release; use `workspace workflow`.

Reads the project's saved pipeline state, so it works with no agent running. A project with nothing
in flight says so and exits 0.

Options:
    --json                       Print JSON ({schema_version, ok, entries}; failures print {schema_version, ok: false, error, code}) instead of a table
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace pipeline status myapp    # what is myapp working on, and when is each stage due
  workspace pipeline status myapp --json    # the same as one document, for a script
  workspace pipeline status api    # a project with nothing in flight says so and exits 0
--- stderr
Warning: `workspace pipeline` is deprecated and will be removed in a later release. Use `workspace workflow` (see `workspace workflow --help`).
--- end

--- exit 0
--- stdout

A project with nothing\nin flight says so and exits 0.","options":[{"flags":"--json","description":"Print JSON ({schema_version, ok, entries}; failures print {schema_version, ok: false, error, code}) instead of a table"},{"flags":"-h, --help","description":"Show this help"}],"examples":[{"command":"workspace pipeline status myapp","scenario":"what is myapp working on, and when is each stage due"},{"command":"workspace pipeline status myapp --json","scenario":"the same as one document, for a script"},{"command":"workspace pipeline status api","scenario":"a project with nothing in flight says so and exits 0"}]}
--- stderr
--- end
### workspace pipeline reset --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace pipeline reset PROJECT [--json]

Clear a stopped project's pipeline state.

This command will be removed in a later release; use `workspace workflow`.

Deletes the project's saved pipeline state. Refused while its agent daemon is running.

Options:
    --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace pipeline reset myapp    # clear leftover state after stopping myapp's agent
  workspace pipeline reset myapp --json    # for a script: one action document, an error document if the agent still runs
  workspace pipeline reset api    # a project with no saved state succeeds too, printing the same line
--- stderr
Warning: `workspace pipeline` is deprecated and will be removed in a later release. Use `workspace workflow` (see `workspace workflow --help`).
--- end
### workspace pipeline reset --help --json
--- exit 0
--- stdout

Refused while its agent daemon is running.","options":[{"flags":"--json","description":"Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text"},{"flags":"-h, --help","description":"Show this help"}],"examples":[{"command":"workspace pipeline reset myapp","scenario":"clear leftover state after stopping myapp's agent"},{"command":"workspace pipeline reset myapp --json","scenario":"for a script: one action document, an error document if the agent still runs"},{"command":"workspace pipeline reset api","scenario":"a project with no saved state succeeds too, printing the same line"}]}
